title: Classic 350 Dark Stealth
description: Representing Royal Enfield's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Royal Enfield Classic 350 Dark Stealth is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 350cc powerplant pumps out 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
